import pytest

from your_module import snake_to_camel


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("value", "expected"),
    [
        ("hello_world", "helloWorld"),
        ("convert_snake_case", "convertSnakeCase"),
        ("user_id", "userId"),
        ("a_b_c", "aBC"),
        ("long_snake_case_string", "longSnakeCaseString"),
    ],
)
def test_snake_to_camel_happy_path(value, expected):
    assert snake_to_camel(value) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("value", "expected"),
    [
        ("", ""),
        ("alreadycamel", "alreadycamel"),
        ("alreadyCamel", "alreadyCamel"),
        ("_", ""),
        ("__", ""),
        ("_leading", "Leading"),
        ("trailing_", "trailing"),
        ("multiple__underscores", "multipleUnderscores"),
        ("multiple___underscores", "multipleUnderscores"),
        ("version_2_id", "version2Id"),
        ("foo_123_bar", "foo123Bar"),
    ],
)
def test_snake_to_camel_edge_cases(value, expected):
    assert snake_to_camel(value) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("value", "expected"),
    [
        ("foo_BAR", "fooBar"),
        ("FOO_bar", "FOOBar"),
        ("foo_bAR_baz", "fooBarBaz"),
        ("FOO_BAR_BAZ", "FOOBarBaz"),
    ],
)
def test_snake_to_camel_preserves_first_part_but_capitalizes_later_parts(value, expected):
    assert snake_to_camel(value) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "value",
    [
        None,
        123,
        12.5,
        ["hello_world"],
        {"hello": "world"},
    ],
)
def test_snake_to_camel_non_string_inputs_without_split_raise_attribute_error(value):
    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
        snake_to_camel(value)  # type: ignore[arg-type]


def test_snake_to_camel_bytes_input_raises_type_error():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        snake_to_camel(b"hello_world")  # type: ignore[arg-type]
